judge.rationale: A common core of FXYD6, KCNQ5, KCNMB4, KCNA3, and KCND3 supports pump/K⁺-conductance explanations, but more than half of the complete molecular content differs through A/D’s tonic GABA and extensive subtype programs, B/D’s morphology-related contributors, and numerous answer-specific channels and regulators, so the shared-minority ceiling of 4 applies.
